MACEDON RANGES FIREWOOD YARD

We Take Pride In Supplying Redgum With The High ‘BTU’

BTU or British Thermal Unit denotes the measurement of wood over its continuous burning cycle from start to finish. Keeping true to this, Macedon Ranges Firewood Yard offers you Redgum firewood with the high BTU for your needs in off-cuts.

Reliable Supply & Delivery

Split, seasoned and ready to burn wood is delivered and loaded with a compatible fleet of machinery and vehicles in and around the Macedon Ranges

No Hand Stacking Hassle

We don’t sell by the hand stacked cubic meter. We load our firewood by a custom built cubic meter bucket and square off the top, so you get exactly what you’ve paid for.

Eco-Friendly & Cost Effective

Redgum is a renewable, low carbon option. Our recycled timber products offer excellent heat output and are an economical choice compared to regular firewood.

Our Redgum Firewood has a very low moisture content as most of our wood is aged 5 years and over, this cured Redgum Firewood can deliver combustion up to one third more compared to regular Redgum aged 1-2 years which has a moisture content of around 20% compared to ours which sits at around 10%. Wood this means you can close down your oxygen and the fire won’t go out and will last to the next morning. At Macedon Ranges Firewood Yard, we offer redgum firewood for domestic as well as commercial clients in Woodend as a sustainable heating solution compared to forestry timber. Specialist in Providing Redgum Wood We are amongst the best you can find. We supply Redgum firewood that is completely and ready to burn. We also supply firewood of small and large sizes that are ready to be used for fireplaces and other heating utilities as well. Our unmatched customer service makes us stand apart.Even if you’re running a business that sells or burns wood, we offer a tailored solution to keep you regularly supplied. Split, seasoned and ready to burn wood is delivered and loaded with a compatible fleet of machinery and vehicles in and around the Macedon Ranges. We don’t allow refunds or come pick up firewood, once payment is made the product is accepted. We don’t sell firewood by the stacked cubic meter, we use a custom made cubic metre measuring bucket that is attached to our front end loader. Do you prefer firewood over gas or electricity? Many people in Woodend use firewood as their main source of heating it has a better renewable carbon-neutral property over gas and electricity and recycled firewood timber products are more eco-friendly, we have economical recycled firewood for sale at a lower price point and higher BTU output than regular Redgum firewood. Why Choose Us? We do our sourcing and supply of Redgum Firewood with the highest BTU or British Thermal Unit. Heartwood from premium saw logs provides exceptional burning qualities with no bark and less sapwood, that’s why recycled firewood products from premium saw logs burns great and even better it is recycled. How Eco-Friendly is it? Highly efficient wood-burning heaters means there is low emission of smoke if the wood. When fire burns wood for longer and thoroughly, much of the gas generated during the combustion gets burnt.So, if you’re concerned about the carbon footprint created using your fireplace our firewood is recognized as carbon neutral to the carbon footprint as it does not release any more carbon dioxide than what wood emits during the bio-degradation on the forest floor. We are ready to take your order and deliver to you as soon as possible. Besides lighting the heart of the home in colder months, we cater to bars, restaurant and shops – where wood-burning fires make the difference all year round. Some of our Redgum that we stock is sawmill off-cuts and sometimes also regular forestry or a mixed blend.
